title: Enrichment Configuration Guide for GreyNoise Intelligence

blocks.text: This configuration guide provides information on prerequisites and how to integrate Zscaler Deception with GreyNoise Intelligence to enhance events that are generated in the Zscaler Deception Admin Portal with additional context.
GreyNoise Intelligence collects, labels, and analyzes internet-wide scan and attack data. It categorizes and tags IP addresses based on activity, threat actor, and tools.
Before you configure the enrichment integration, ensure that you have:

blocks.item: Network connectivity from the Deception Admin Portal to the GreyNoise Intelligence API server.
Obtained the GreyNoise Intelligence API key. To learn more, refer to the GreyNoise Intelligence documentation.

blocks.heading: Configuring the Enrichment Integration with GreyNoise Intelligence

blocks.text: To configure the enrichment integrationwith GreyNoise Intelligence:

blocks.item: Locate GreyNoise Intelligence in the table, and click the Edit icon under the Actions column.
Enter the GreyNoise Intelligence API key.
The enrichment integration with GreyNoise Intelligence is enabled.
